nodes.text: Pip wants to make a friendly trail of lights. Which way shall we begin?
A duck has left a gap in the little lantern line. Help Pip make the path clear.
From the hill, Pip spots a lantern line with a gap. Help fill it so neighbours can follow.
The trail glows. What shall we look for next?
Pip spots a star-shaped sparkle beyond the hill. You can follow that night-sky mystery on another adventure.
A rustle curls through the leaves beside the lantern trail. Pip saves that woodland clue for your next adventure.
